# Tape Lounge

> An interactive market lounge for reading crypto price action, exchange flows, and historical chart behaviour.

## Start here
- [Live lounge](https://tapelounge.com/): market-session comparison, a short crypto race, candle deck, BTC chart and indicators, simulated position panel, lounge chat, live trade flow, and order book.
- [Blind chart challenge](https://tapelounge.com/blind/?daily=1): trade a shared historical stock or crypto chart with virtual funds, then compare the result with holding over the same period.
- [BTC decision practice (English)](https://tapelounge.com/en/decision/): choose buy, wait, hold, or exit at historical BTC chart moments, reveal the next five days after each choice, and compare the virtual result with holding. This is retrospective practice, not a live signal or evidence of predictive skill. Localized: [한국어](https://tapelounge.com/decision/) · [中文](https://tapelounge.com/zh/decision/) · [日本語](https://tapelounge.com/ja/decision/).
- [How the blind chart challenge works](https://tapelounge.com/ko/learn/blind-chart-practice/): scoring, limitations, and practice details.
- [English edition](https://tapelounge.com/en/)
- [中文版本](https://tapelounge.com/zh/)
- [日本語版](https://tapelounge.com/ja/)

## Live market rooms
- [Korean markets](https://tapelounge.com/domestic/): Korean exchange prices, FX context, Kimchi premium, and the Andy observation list.
- [Futures desk](https://tapelounge.com/desk/): futures market context, funding, price levels, and order book.
- [Long-term chart analysis](https://tapelounge.com/analysis/): BTC linear price channels and technical chart context.
- [On-chain room](https://tapelounge.com/onchain/): selected network, exchange-flow, and mempool indicators.
- [Economic calendar](https://tapelounge.com/calendar/): scheduled releases and reported results.
- [Strategists](https://tapelounge.com/strategists/): labeled AI analyst viewpoints, research notes, and strategy records.

## Public data and feeds
- [Observation snapshots](https://tapelounge.com/data/andy-watch.json): published candidate states and retained history; list removal is not a trade or stop-loss.
- [Public site summary](https://tapelounge.com/data/discovery.json): public report summaries, coverage, and generation times.
- [Market event archive](https://tapelounge.com/data/scenes.json): recent public events associated with closed spot candles; sequence does not prove causation or completeness.
- [Sitemap](https://tapelounge.com/sitemap.xml)
- [Korean RSS](https://tapelounge.com/ko/feed.xml) · [English RSS](https://tapelounge.com/en/feed.xml) · [中文 RSS](https://tapelounge.com/zh/feed.xml) · [日本語 RSS](https://tapelounge.com/ja/feed.xml)

## Reading notes
- Live values are fetched in the browser from public market-data sources; they may be delayed, unavailable, or differ from executable exchange prices.
- Simulated positions and blind-chart results use virtual funds and do not place real orders or establish investment performance.
- Strategist names are labeled AI personas, not independent human analysts. Their observations are not buy or sell instructions.
- Editorial pages are available in Korean, English, Chinese, and Japanese. Interactive market rooms are primarily Korean.
- This file is a navigation aid for readers and agents, not a guarantee of search ranking or indexing. Normal page metadata, sitemap, and `robots.txt` still govern crawling.
